title: AliienChatColor - LITE
description: Lite version of my original chat color plugin
body:
> **⭐ This is the FREE/LITE version of AliienChatColor! [Premium Download Links](https://aliien.gitbook.io/aliien-docs/aliienchatcolor/getting-started) ⭐**

### 🎨 Why Choose AliienChatColor Lite?
AliienChatColor Lite is the ultimate lightweight chat colors plugin for your Minecraft server! It allows you to add a brand new type of chat-based cosmetics to your server, giving your players access to beautiful single colors and multi-color gradients while remaining incredibly optimized.

### ✨ Key Features
* **Highly Optimized:** This plugin has been tested and proven to be incredibly efficient in terms of performance. It handles chat formatting with zero impact on your server's TPS.
* **Custom Gradients & Hex Support:** This plugin uses MiniMessage, which means you can format your chat colors in the config using exact hex codes (e.g., `<#FF0000>`) or stunning multi-color gradients!
* **PlaceholderAPI Integration:** PlaceholderAPI is an optional dependency, allowing you to easily hook your players' active chat colors into your favorite chat formatting plugins (like EssentialsChat or Chatty).

### ⌨️ Commands & Permissions
AliienChatColor provides granular control over exactly what your players can do.

**Player Commands:**
* `/cc set <color>` - Manually equip a specific chat color from the config.
  * *Permissions:* `aliien.chatcolor.set` AND `aliien.color.<colorId>` (e.g., `aliien.color.cotton_candy`)
* `/cc clear` - Removes your active chat color.
  * *Permission:* `aliien.chatcolor.clear`

**Admin Commands:**
* `/cc admin reload` - Safely reloads the config and messages files.
  * *Permission:* `aliien.chatcolor.admin.reload` (Base permission: `aliien.chatcolor.admin`)

**Other Permissions:**
* `aliien.chatcolor.version-notify` - Receive in-game notifications when a new plugin update is released.

### 🔌 Available Placeholders
* `%aliienchatcolor_format%` - Returns the raw MiniMessage tags of the active color (e.g., `<#FF0000>`)
* `%aliienchatcolor_active%` - Returns the raw ID of the player's equipped color (e.g., `cotton_candy`).
* `%aliienchatcolor_has_<colorId>%` - Returns "True" or "False" if the player has permission for that specific color.

### 📦 Dependencies & Installation
* **Permissions Plugin:** Required (e.g., LuckPerms).
* **PlaceholderAPI:** Optional.

1. Download the latest `AliienChatColor-Lite.jar`.
2. Drop the `.jar` file into your server's `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart your server.
